notes.title: Perseverance Rover is coming to Mars on Feb, 18th!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Rover Mechanics![/h1]

[h3][b]Perseverance Rover[/b] will be landing on Mars on Feb, 18th![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/ef6bb939f400a424b7758274cc9d78547618afd4.png[/img]

On this occasion the shiny new Rover is also [b]coming to Rover Mechanic Simulator in the form of DLC[/b]!

At first glance the new Rover may seem similar to it's older brother Curiosity, but in reality it's very very different. For the last few months we've been working very hard on preparing the Perseverance Rover model [b]completely from scratch[/b] to make it as accurate as possible. 

Prepare to learn more about it and tinker with about 200 new unique parts! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1512110/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator__Perseverance_Rover_DLC/

We are counting down in anticipation for the release and keeping our fingers crossed for the safe landing on Mars! Below you can watch the [b]Official JPL Perseverance Rover landing video[/b]:

[previewyoutube=tITni_HY1Bk;full][/previewyoutube]

Yours Sincerely,
Rover Mechanic Simulator Team
https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/

notes.title: ERC Rover Mechanic Challenge
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Martians![/h1]

We are thrilled to announce that 𝗘𝗥𝗖 𝗥𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗠𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗰 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗲 will be held this weekend (Sep 11th - 13th) during [b][url=https://roverchallenge.eu/en/about-the-erc/]ERC Space and Robotics Event 2020[/url][/b].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1368970/Rover_Mechanic_Challenge__ERC_Competition/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38501611/a3355068bf38489476ea68a748fd44fe79f34a0f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3][b]About ERC RMC:[/b][/h3]
𝗘𝗥𝗖 𝗥𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗠𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗰 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗲 is an e-tournament based on the world's only simulator for repairing Mars Rovers. This is a special version of Rover Mechanic Simulator created in cooperation with [b]European Rover Challenge - Space & Robotics Event 2020[/b]. 

[h3][b]About e-tournament:[/b][/h3]
Participants of the competition will take part in challenging tasks, which require them to fix Mars Rovers as quickly as possible. Every hour, 4 participants will play at the same time. Each person's task is to fix 4 Mars Rovers (including Curiosity!), which will have a random malfunction to fix each hour. Only one of the participants will win the possibility to remotely control the real rover on Mars Yard!

[b]➡️The tournament ladder can be found here:[/b] https://challonge.com/g7k3g7ey 

[b]➡️ ERC Rover Mechanic Challenge official rules:[/b] https://pyramid.games/media/ERC_RMC_Terms_English.pdf

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38501611/1265ed8f34cb12d651d004f2c57c999acfbb30c8.jpg[/img]

📌[b]Friday (Sep 11th) [/b]
[u]Group Stage:[/u] https://challonge.com/pl/g7k3g7ey

📌[b]Saturday (Sep 12th)[/b]
[u]Semi-final stage:[/u] https://challonge.com/pl/g7k3g7ey/bracket
[list] [*] Match #1: 11:00 a.m. CEST
[*] Match #2: 12:00  p.m. CEST
[*] Match #3: 13:00  p.m. CEST
[*] Match #4: 14:00  p.m. CEST

Don’t miss the live streams of the competition which will be held this weekend (Sep 11th-13th) on our channels:
